name: @beromir/neos-studio-icon-select-editor
comment: The Studio plugin API TYPES come from the installed Medienreaktor.NeosStudio package (tsconfig.json paths); at runtime it and react/react-dom are marked external in vite.config.ts and resolved from the shell's copy on window (see src/main.tsx). All build/type-time only. Keep react majors aligned with the host so types match.
